title: Velo Lime Flame Slim Nicotine Pouches - Original (8mg)
description: Velo Slim Lime Flame Nicotine Pouches deliver the zesty citrus taste of Lime lifted by an aromatic chilli spice note, producing a flavour that tastes sharp, tangy and warmly spiced. The unusual combination of citrus brightness and jalapeño warmth makes Lime Flame one of the more distinctive blends. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, offering an easy and practical option wherever you are. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide range of strengths and flavours. Lime Flame is presented here in a Medium 8mg strength, offering a balanced release of flavour and nicotine. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
